# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.sh from the real CLI. Do not edit by hand. -->

```
usage: clipsdaily [-h] [--version] [--home DIR] COMMAND ...

Fully automatic stream clip pipeline: record, cut, post.

positional arguments:
  COMMAND
    run       live runner (record + spikes + cut + post)
    post      post clips
    queue     clip queue
    campaign  campaign automation
    submit    auto-submit outbox
    earnings  earnings summary / update
    auth      auth setup and checks

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --version   show program's version number and exit
  --home DIR  runtime home (default: $CLIPSDAILY_HOME or cwd)
```

## clipsdaily run

```
usage: clipsdaily run [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## clipsdaily post

```
usage: clipsdaily post [-h] POST ...

positional arguments:
  POST
    now       post the next pending queue clip now
    one       post one queue clip by id
    hourly    hourly poster loop (slots :00/:30)

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## clipsdaily post now

```
usage: clipsdaily post now [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## clipsdaily post one

```
usage: clipsdaily post one [-h] clip_id [slot]

positional arguments:
  clip_id     queue entry id, e.g. jynxzi-2928767125-12505s
  slot        slot label (default: current hour)

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## clipsdaily post hourly

```
usage: clipsdaily post hourly [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## clipsdaily queue

```
usage: clipsdaily queue [-h] QUEUE ...

positional arguments:
  QUEUE
    status    show queue counts + next clip
    maintain  maintainer loop (seed >=24)
    seed      cut clips until N pending, then exit

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

```
usage: clipsdaily queue status [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

```
usage: clipsdaily queue maintain [-h]

options:

```

## clipsdaily queue seed

```
usage: clipsdaily queue seed [-h] [target]

```

## clipsdaily campaign

```
usage: clipsdaily campaign [-h] CAMPAIGN ...

positional arguments:
  CAMPAIGN
    watch     watch Content Rewards for campaigns
    cut       cut clips for a joined campaign

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## clipsdaily campaign watch

```
usage: clipsdaily campaign watch [-h] [--check] [--dry-run] [--discover-only]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --check          full run (default)
  --dry-run
  --discover-only
```

## clipsdaily campaign cut

```
usage: clipsdaily campaign cut [-h] --campaign CAMPAIGN
                               [--max-clips MAX_CLIPS] [--dry-run]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --campaign CAMPAIGN   campaign id
  --max-clips MAX_CLIPS
  --dry-run
```

## clipsdaily submit

```
usage: clipsdaily submit [-h] ACTION ...

positional arguments:
  ACTION
    scan          scan queue for submittable clips
    list-pending  list pending submit jobs (JSON)
    write-job     write one submit job
    mark-submitted
                  mark a job submitted
    mark-failed   mark a job failed

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
```
